The habit that makes it stick
Simply writing down what you eat is one of the strongest predictors of maintaining a healthy weight for good.
Hit your protein and calorie targets consistently and you build lean mass far faster than training alone.
Most people misjudge what they eat by about a third. Just seeing the real numbers is often enough to shift habits.
People who log their meals consistently lose about twice as much weight as those who don't — and keep it off longer.
